links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of LLM patient education answers versus RCOG originals
links.effect: ChatGPT answers were harder to read than BARD, Bing, and the original RCOG answers; no numeric grade levels are given in the abstract.
links.quote: In terms of readability, ChatGPT exhibited higher difficulty than BARD, Bing, and the original RCOG answers.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, completeness, precision, and readability of three commercial LLMs (GPT, BARD, Bing) on patient education questions regarding pelvic organ prolapse without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
